autocomplete_and_input_purpose_note: Autocomplete and input-purpose cues help user agents distinguish repeated user fields without silently changing the authoritative answer path.
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that require typed, pasted, or autofilled user input preserve clear field purpose, sensible keyboard/input hints, and value-preserving correction paths so the current official answer does not depend on guesswork about how to enter the query.
error_identification_note: Entry failures identify the field and problem in text rather than by color or generic banners alone.
error_suggestion_note: When a safe correction is known, the route offers a practical suggestion or example for retry.
field_entry_surface_label: Example State official voter-information field-entry fail-open policy
field_purpose_and_label_note: Critical fields expose task-accurate labels and format cues so voters can tell what data belongs in each field before validation fires.
format_expectation_note: Unusual date, ID, or address formatting requirements are visible in text and do not depend on placeholder-only hints.
input_mask_and_inline_formatting_note: Masks or inline formatting helpers do not trap deletion, break paste, or obscure the value the voter actually entered.
keyboard_hint_and_inputmode_note: Keyboard/input hints align with expected data types and mobile entry posture without being treated as the full validation story.
paste_and_copy_entry_note: Common pasted or copied values such as ZIP codes, addresses, and confirmation numbers survive ordinary review and correction.
same_answer_across_input_variants_note: Different keyboards, autofill options, or browser entry helpers may change interaction posture but do not silently change the authoritative answer.
value_preservation_and_retry_note: Failed lookups preserve enough entered information that the voter can retry without retyping the full query from scratch.
